title: timeline (widget tool input)
description: What the agent sends to the widget tool: the payload without id, rev and producer (the tool sets them); fallback_text optional (the tool writes it); from_file allowed. Events in order on a rail: a package on its way, a history, an incident log, a day of travel, with the current event ringed.

time.description: When it happened or is expected. A date-time when it is known to the minute; a date when only the day is known (shown as the day, never as 00:00); null when nobody knows yet (shown as —).

end.description: The end of a window: a delivery slot, a stay, a meeting. Shown as a range: “Expected 1–3 PM”.

title.description: What happened or will happen, in a few words: “Shipped”, “Rolled back to 1.3.1”, “UA 1187 to San Francisco”.

detail.description: One line under the title: “UPS 1Z999AA10123456784 · from Portland”, “EWR C → SFO T3 · gate C112”.

state.description: The dot. done: a green check (it happened). current: the ringed ink dot, the one “now” (at most one per timeline). upcoming: a hollow circle (expected). info / warning / critical: the state glyph in its colour, for incident logs and problems on the way (a customs hold, a delay). unverified: a dashed ring with a question mark (reported, not confirmed). cancelled: a grey dash and a struck-through title.

glyph.description: A small symbol before the title for the kind of step: airplane, tram.fill, bed.double.fill, shippingbox.fill. The dot still carries the state.

name.description: Where, in a few words: “EWR Terminal C”, “200 W 57th St”, “Zoom”.

address.description: The street address when it isn’t the name.

url.description: A call link (Zoom, Meet, FaceTime web) or the place’s page. Join / Open shows the domain first.

place.description: A place. With lat and lon the row’s menu offers Directions (opens Maps on this device); with url, Join or Open.

who.description: Who did it or who it waits on: the on-call engineer, the courier, a Bot. Shown at the end of the detail line; required reading in incident logs.

evidence.description: How the event is known: the deploy log, the carrier’s scan, “Said by the seller”. A caption line under the detail with a small glyph.

actions.description: Up to two buttons on the row. A reply action sends its id with `{item: <id>}`.

items.description: One event. The client never changes its state by itself.

events.description: The events, oldest first. Empty only with the envelope’s `empty_text` (nothing has happened yet).

direction.description: past: tracking and history; the time column is relative (Today, Tue, 12 Oct) and Show all folds the oldest. future: an itinerary; clock times in each place’s local time, a day caption when the day changes, Show all folds the latest, and a thin “Now” tick between events when none is current.

kind.description: incident: exact clock times on every row (with the date when the log crosses midnight), `who` on each row, state colours as severity. Put the outage’s length in the subtitle: “Checkout outage · 28 min”.
